cases.name: an unknown family
cases.refused: Give `family`: surface (what a screen shows), flow (how the experience is walked through) or foundation (what the rest is built on).

cases.name: no family
cases.refused: Give `family`: surface (what a screen shows), flow (how the experience is walked through) or foundation (what the rest is built on).

cases.name: a framing of two lines
cases.refused: Give `framing`: one line saying what the user is about to evaluate.

cases.name: no intent
cases.refused: Give `intent`: one line saying what the user should notice. It is your own check and is not shown.

cases.name: no cards
cases.refused: Give `cards`: at least one, each with a claim and its evidence. A decision shows before it asks.

cases.name: a card that asks

cards.reference: Against a table: denser, but no avatars.

cases.refused: Card 1 asks something. A decision has one ask, given once in `ask`; a doubt about a place on the evidence is a pin.

cases.name: a card without claim

cards.reference: Against a table: denser, but no avatars.

cases.refused: Card 1 has no `claim`: say what the evidence shows, e.g. “The screen ended up like this”.

cases.name: an unknown evidence
cases.refused: Card 1 has no `evidence`: an object with `type` (image, diagram) and the board element it shows.

cases.name: an image without after
cases.refused: Card 1: give the image to evaluate in `after` (and the one it replaces in `before`).

cases.name: in a vacuum

cards.reference: Against a table: denser, but no avatars.

cases.refused: Card 2 is evaluated in a vacuum: give `before`, or a `reference` line with the justification or the alternative. Precedent is not a justification.

cases.name: a pin outside

cards.reference: Against a table: denser, but no avatars.

cases.refused: Card 1: a pin takes `x` and `y` from 0 to 1 (from the evidence's top left) and its `question`.

cases.name: a diagram without svg
cases.refused: Card 1: give the diagram's SVG in `svg`.

cases.name: a diagram that cannot be drawn
cases.refused: Card 1: the diagram can't be drawn. `<image>` isn't drawn. A diagram draws shapes and text only.

cases.refused: Card 1 is evaluated in a vacuum: give `before`, or a `reference` line with the justification or the alternative. Precedent is not a justification.

cases.name: two asks
cases.refused: One decision, one ask: `ask` is a single object. A second question is a second decision.

cases.name: an ask without question
cases.refused: Give `ask`: an object with the `question`, and `variants` when the user picks between alternatives.

cases.name: one variant
cases.refused: A choice takes 2 to 4 variants (three for something new); you gave 1. With one, ask for validation: leave `variants` out.

cases.name: a long variant name
cases.refused: Variant 2 needs a `name` of at most 3 words, e.g. “Dense list”; the rest goes in `detail`.

cases.name: nothing verified
cases.refused: Give `verified`: what you checked before asking, one line each. Nothing reaches the user unverified; what can't be verified is its own decision saying what stops you.
